tagline.en: US 51 upgraded, and mostly hidden inside other routes
tagline.zh: 由 US 51 升级而来，大半藏在别的路线里

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 伊利诺伊州布卢明顿—诺默尔，与 I-55 相接

end.en: Wisconsin Highway 29 at Rib Mountain, near Wausau, Wisconsin
end.zh: 威斯康星州沃索附近的里布山，与 WIS 29 相接

en: I-39 is a north–south route through the middle of Illinois and Wisconsin, built almost entirely by upgrading US 51 rather than on new ground. From Bloomington–Normal it runs up past El Paso and Minonk to the Illinois River at La Salle–Peru, on through Rochelle to Rockford, and into Wisconsin.

North of the state line it largely disappears. Of the 182 miles Wisconsin claims for the route, only about 103 are on alignment of its own; the rest is signed along I-90 and then I-90/I-94 through Beloit, Janesville and Madison before the number separates again at Portage and heads north on its own through Stevens Point to Wausau.

It ends at Wisconsin Highway 29 south of Wausau, where US 51 — the road it replaced — carries the freeway on for a short distance and then continues north as an ordinary highway towards Merrill. The designation broke a state rule in the process: Wisconsin does not allow a highway number to be duplicated across Interstate, US and state routes, and WIS 39 already existed.
zh: I-39 是一条纵贯伊利诺伊与威斯康星中部的南北向路线，几乎全部由 US 51 升级而成，而非新辟线位。它自布卢明顿—诺默尔北上，经埃尔帕索与米农克抵达拉萨尔—佩鲁的伊利诺伊河，再经罗谢尔至罗克福德，然后进入威斯康星。
过了州界，它在很大程度上消失了。威斯康星为这条路线登记的 182 英里中，只有约 103 英里位于它自己的线位上；其余部分先标示在 I-90 上，随后沿 I-90/I-94 穿过贝洛伊特、简斯维尔与麦迪逊，直到波蒂奇才重新分出，独立北上经史蒂文斯波因特抵达沃索。
它止于沃索以南的 WIS 29；在那里，被它取代的 US 51 把高速公路又向前带一小段，随后作为普通干线继续北往梅里尔。这个编号在设立过程中还打破了一项州规：威斯康星不允许州际公路、联邦公路与州级公路之间出现重号，而 WIS 39 早已存在。

en: Illinois officials had been pressing for a route along US 51 since 1945. The freeway went in piece by piece: a stretch from Rochelle to Rockford in 1984, south to I-80 by 1986, on to IL 251 by December 1987, and a new alignment from I-80 near La Salle down to Oglesby in early 1989, carried across the Illinois River on the Abraham Lincoln Memorial Bridge.

Getting the number was harder than building the road. Illinois applied to AASHTO in October 1984 and was turned down that December, the committee recommending a three-digit spur instead; the state asked again in January 1985 and the designation was approved in a letter dated 5 February 1985. The Illinois route was finished on 31 October 1992 with a ceremony at US 24 near El Paso.

Wisconsin designated its portion in 1992, and in October 1993 AASHTO approved the extension north from Rockford. Signs did not follow quickly: the stretch from Portage to Rib Mountain was posted in 1996, after a five-year push and a designation by the governor, and the overlap along I-90 and I-94 was not signed until late 1998. The first road atlas to show I-39 in Wisconsin appeared in 1999.
zh: 伊利诺伊的官员自 1945 年起就在争取一条沿 US 51 的路线。高速公路是一段一段建成的：1984 年通车罗谢尔至罗克福德段，1986 年南接 I-80，1987 年 12 月延至 IL 251，1989 年初又建成自拉萨尔附近 I-80 南下至奥格尔斯比的新线位，并以亚伯拉罕·林肯纪念大桥跨越伊利诺伊河。
拿到编号比修路更难。伊利诺伊于 1984 年 10 月向美国州公路与运输工作者协会申请，当年 12 月被驳回，编号委员会建议改设三位数支线；该州于 1985 年 1 月再次申请，编号在一封日期为 1985 年 2 月 5 日的函件中获批。伊利诺伊段于 1992 年 10 月 31 日在埃尔帕索附近的 US 24 处举行仪式后建成。
威斯康星于 1992 年为本州路段定编，1993 年 10 月，美国州公路与运输工作者协会批准了自罗克福德向北的延伸。标志却迟迟未至：波蒂奇至里布山段在经历五年推动、并由州长正式指定后，才于 1996 年挂牌；沿 I-90 与 I-94 的并线段直到 1998 年底才标示。第一本标出威斯康星 I-39 的公路地图册出版于 1999 年。

en: The largest single investment on the route is at its northern end. Wisconsin enumerated the I-39/US 51 Wausau Corridor as a major project in 2001 and rebuilt seven miles between Foxglove Road and Bridge Street, widening a four-lane divided highway to six lanes with auxiliary lanes between closely spaced interchanges, replacing both WIS 29 system interchanges with free-flowing designs, and adding a parallel local road system to take pressure off the freeway at peak times.

The work ran from 2004 to 2010: the eastern system interchange opened in 2006, three of the four ramps at the western one in 2008, and the last ramps in September 2010. The design left room to expand to eight lanes later.

The project became an argument about forecasting. WisDOT's traffic projection for the corridor's opening year had a wide range, and the counts taken in the year it opened came in below the bottom of it — a gap that critics used to question whether a corridor of this size was needed.
zh: 这条路线上最大的单项投资位于北端。威斯康星于 2001 年把 I-39/US 51 沃索走廊列为重大项目，重建了福克斯格洛夫路至布里奇街之间的七英里：把四车道分隔式公路拓宽为六车道，并在间距很近的立交之间增设辅助车道；将 WIS 29 的两处枢纽立交改建为自由流式；同时新建一套平行的地方道路系统，以缓解高峰时段高速公路的压力。
工程自 2004 年持续到 2010 年：东侧枢纽立交 2006 年开放，西侧枢纽四条匝道中的三条 2008 年开放，最后几条匝道在 2010 年 9 月开放。设计为日后拓至八车道预留了空间。
这个项目后来变成一场关于交通预测的争论。威斯康星州交通部对该走廊通车年份的车流预测区间很宽，而通车当年的实测值却低于该区间的下限——批评者正是用这一落差来质疑是否需要这种规模的走廊。

why.en: No agency has published a total, and FHWA's route-by-route accounting of the Interstate Construction programme has no line for I-39 at all: the number was created in 1985, after that programme's cost estimates were settled. A figure of about $622 million for the Illinois section circulates in road-enthusiast compilations of contemporary newspaper reports, but no agency document stands behind it.
why.zh: 没有任何机构公布过总额，而联邦公路管理局按路线编制的州际建设计划账目中根本没有 I-39 这一行：这个编号设立于 1985 年，晚于该计划成本估算的定案。公路爱好者依当年报纸报道汇编出的「伊利诺伊段约 6.22 亿美元」一说流传较广，但其背后并无任何机构文件。

value.en: 322.08 miles — 182.04 in Wisconsin and 140.04 in Illinois. Wisconsin's own application to AASHTO noted that only about 103 of its 182 miles are independent of another Interstate
value.zh: 322.08 英里——威斯康星 182.04 英里，伊利诺伊 140.04 英里。威斯康星向美国州公路与运输工作者协会提交的申请指出，其 182 英里中仅约 103 英里不与其他州际公路并线

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026; WisDOT application to AASHTO, approved 22 October 1993

value.en: $290.7 million as enumerated by WisDOT — $281.7 million of construction plus $9.0 million of other costs — for seven miles in Marathon County, on budget against the enumerated figure. An outside review of Wisconsin highway spending put the completed project at $309 million
value.zh: 按威斯康星州交通部立项口径为 2.907 亿美元——其中施工 2.817 亿美元，其他费用 900 万美元——用于马拉松县的七英里路段，与立项数额相比未超支。一份外部的威斯康星公路支出评估将竣工造价列为 3.09 亿美元

figures.source: WisDOT major highway projects status report, enumeration year 2001; WISPIRG, Road Overkill, May 2013

value.en: A 1999 baseline count of 40,000–56,000 vehicles a day; WisDOT projected 52,400–78,800 for 2010; counts taken in May 2010 came in at 50,400–54,900, about 3.8 per cent below the bottom of the forecast range. The 2020 projection was 62,300–93,200
value.zh: 1999 年基准计数为日均 40,000 至 56,000 辆；威斯康星州交通部对 2010 年的预测为 52,400 至 78,800 辆；2010 年 5 月的实测为 50,400 至 54,900 辆，约低于预测区间下限 3.8%。对 2020 年的预测为 62,300 至 93,200 辆

trafficFigures.source: WisDOT forecasts and counts, as compiled by WISPIRG, Road Overkill, May 2013

why.en: Any route average would be meaningless here, because more than a third of the mileage is shared with I-90 and I-94 around Madison and is counted under those routes.
why.zh: 在这里，任何全线平均值都没有意义：超过三分之一的里程与麦迪逊一带的 I-90、I-94 共线，并被计入那些路线。

value.en: Seven miles widened from four to six lanes with room to reach eight later, two system interchanges and six service interchanges rebuilt, and 14 grade separation structures designed
value.zh: 七英里路段由四车道拓为六车道并预留八车道空间，重建两处枢纽立交与六处服务型立交，并设计了 14 座跨线结构物

conditionFigures.source: WisDOT major highway projects status report; Ayres Associates project record

timeline.en: Illinois officials begin advocating a route along US 51 between Salem and South Beloit.
timeline.zh: 伊利诺伊官员开始倡议沿 US 51 修建一条自塞勒姆至南贝洛伊特的路线。

timeline.en: Illinois applies for the I-39 designation in October and is turned down in December.
timeline.zh: 伊利诺伊于 10 月申请 I-39 编号，12 月被驳回。

timeline.en: AASHTO approves the designation in a letter dated 5 February.
timeline.zh: 美国州公路与运输工作者协会在 2 月 5 日的函件中批准该编号。

timeline.en: The Abraham Lincoln Memorial Bridge carries the new alignment across the Illinois River.
timeline.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯纪念大桥承载新线位跨越伊利诺伊河。

timeline.en: The Illinois section is completed on 31 October; Wisconsin designates its own portion.
timeline.zh: 伊利诺伊段于 10 月 31 日建成；威斯康星为本州路段定编。

timeline.en: AASHTO approves the extension north from Rockford to Wausau in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，美国州公路与运输工作者协会批准自罗克福德北延至沃索。

timeline.en: Wisconsin posts I-39 signs from Portage to Rib Mountain.
timeline.zh: 威斯康星在波蒂奇至里布山段挂出 I-39 标志。

timeline.en: The overlap along I-90 and I-94 is signed for I-39 in late autumn.
timeline.zh: 深秋时节，沿 I-90 与 I-94 的并线段挂出 I-39 标志。

timeline.en: The Wausau corridor reconstruction is completed, the last ramps opening in September.
timeline.zh: 沃索走廊改建完工，最后几条匝道于 9 月开放。
